text:
La Gazzetta dello Sport
Italy roars
Three goals against France in San Siro, we are first in the group
Sensational comeback by the Azzurri, inspired by Pio Esposito: two goals. Mancini: ‘Brilliant, I’m very happy’. Just a draw in Belgium on Sunday to get to the quarter-finals
Roma’s fearsome attack, but Inter creating more
The best in the league
A new path for referees: Reds and penalties on the decline
Corriere dello Sport
Thank you, Mancio
Marvellous Italy | Nations League: 3-1 against France, now first in the group
A lesson to Zidane: Esposito setting records
A brace from Pio (nine goals in 14 caps) and a goal from Frattesi overturn the opener from Olise (a mistake from Gigio), also a missed penalty from Seba. The CT says: ‘A great performance, now we win in Belgium’
San Siro ovation and Kimi is impressed: ‘Wow’
Tuttosport
We are back
Italy 3-1France 
Pio (brace) and Frattesi gift a second-half victory marked by a resurgence of the intensity of old times 
Not discouraged by falling behind after Donnarumma’s error (goal from Olise), or by the penalty that was missed at 1-1 by Sebastiano Esposito, redeemed by his brother a moment later (nine goals in 14 Azzurri caps): ‘I scored for him as well’. Mancini masterpiece: They had not beaten Italy at home for 64 years. In Brussels on Sunday against Belgium to seal an incredible first-place finish in the group
Juve-Varela: Battle with Napoli
Carnevali tries for the Monza bomber: Costs at least 30 million
Kolo Muani and Woltemade aren’t scoring much (the top scorer is … Bremer), they need a true centre-forward. Ravanelli and Giaccherini: ‘We would sign him!’. Need to see off Manna, but it will be tough in January: The Sorloth, Balogun and Scamacca options remain open
De Bryne, goodbye to Allegri
Going in January?
He will not renew his contract with Napoli, PSV call him, he opens up: ‘We’ll see’
Toro, eyes on Biondini
The Empoli talent The 17-year-old midfielder is already a key player in Serie V. Petrachi tries to get ahead of the competition

נבחרת איטליה רשמה ניצחון מרשים בסן סירו כשגברה 3-1 על נבחרת צרפת והעפילה למקום הראשון בבית במסגרת ליגת האומות. הצרפתים עלו ליתרון מוקדם בעקבות שער של אוליסה לאחר טעות של השוער דונארומה, אך האיטלקים הפכו את תוצאת המשחק.

פיו אספוזיטו הצטיין במשחק וכבש צמד שערים לזכות האזורי, כשאליו הצטרף דוידה פראטסי עם שער נוסף. המאמן לוצ'יאנו ספאלטי וצוותו חגגו את ההישג, וכעת זקוקה איטליה רק לתוצאת תיקו מול בלגיה כדי להבטיח את המקום בשלב רבע הגמר.
